items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: Charlie Echols... stood in front of the band like Cab and he would sing these songs and he would conduct the band and shake his head because he imitated Cab... he was the west coast's Cab Calloway

ctx.x: What was the Brownskin Review? That wasn't at the Arabee?
No, that wasn't at the Arabee. I know what that was; I'll get to that. I think I do.

All right, so after the Arabee, it seems the band broke up and like you mentioned, Charlie Echols. Charlie Echols was the west coast's Cab Calloway. Charles Echols. He used to get a lot of gigs -- but he always wanted the best musicians. He could not play a note, but he stood in front of the band like Cab and he would sing these songs and he would conduct the band and shake his head because he imitated Cab, really, but not -- he couldn't scat and all that, but I mean he was the west coast's Cab Calloway, and he…
